# Infrastructure Domain - API & Microservices Infrastructure Patterns

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Patterns](../../README.md) • [Infrastructure](../README.md)**

This directory contains infrastructure-level patterns for API and microservices platforms within the **Infrastructure Domain**. These patterns focus on the underlying infrastructure, platform services, and operational capabilities that support microservices applications.
page_texts.2:
[patterns/infrastructure/api-microservices/README.md#overview]

## Overview

Infrastructure patterns for APIs and microservices address:

- **Platform Services**: Service mesh, API gateways, service discovery
- **Infrastructure Management**: GitOps, Infrastructure as Code, configuration management
- **Operational Capabilities**: Monitoring, logging, disaster recovery
- **Resource Management**: Cost allocation, capacity planning, multi-cluster management
- **Network Infrastructure**: Ingress, egress, service connectivity
